entities.summary: Bradley Michael Snyder is an American former professional baseball outfielder. He was raised in Bellevue, Ohio, and attended Ball State University from 2001 to 2003. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Chicago Cubs and Texas Rangers. He also played in the KBO League for the LG Twins and Nexen Heroes.
